contract.task_clause:
According to COSO, an effective approach to monitoring internal control involves each of the following steps, except
Option A: Establishing a foundation for monitoring.
Option B: Increasing the reliability of financial reporting and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Option C: Designing and executing monitoring procedures that are prioritized based on risks to achieve organizational objectives.
Option D: Assessing and reporting the results, including following up on corrective action where necessary.
